title: Where does the update key live, and who approves each release?
recommendation: The Mac Studio's keychain. After a release build passes, a Claude session runs scripts/release-approve.sh there (releasing is already a routine call)
body: Options: Mac Studio, approved by a session (no busywork for Jordan) · Jordan's laptop, approved by Jordan running one command · approved automatically by a job on the Studio (no human in the loop: a hacked main branch would ship).
